title: quercus robur var. brachyphylla
intro: Quercus robur var. brachyphylla, commonly known as the dwarf English oak, is a variety of oak tree that belongs to the Quercus robur species. The dwarf English oak is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting digestive health, reducing inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Quercus robur var. brachyphylla include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins. These compounds have been found to have hepatoprotective, cardioprotective, and anti-cancer properties, making Quercus robur var. brachyphylla a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
